title: How Puzzles That Look Easy But Took Over So Fast
hook: The World's Hardest Game is a 2007 Flash maze game
script:
The World's Hardest Game is a 2007 Flash maze game developed by Stephen Critoph, also known as Snubby Land.
That is not a guess – it is what the science actually says.
In it, players control a red square and must get from one end of a maze to another while avoiding obstacles and collecting coins.
It was also released for iOS in 2009.
And that is the real story of Puzzles That Look Easy But Are Actually IMPOSSIBLE!.
